notes.title: Very Minor Update
notes.notes:
- Added a few minor changes to the functionality and the text on the beginning screen.
- Updated the feature that slows time when the player collides with an enemy. The change is very subtle.

Thank you for playing [i]Vainly[/i]! I continue to support and improve the game to make sure you have the best possible experience. 

There are still a few minor problems and random bugs in the game. I'm trying my best to fix them as soon as possible. If you found a bug that impacted your experience (even in a very minor way), please let me know the details by emailing me at:

[url=mailto:contact@alisaneei.com]contact@alisaneei.com[/url]


Thank you very much for your support! And happy new year!
